Container.Name: is-it-worth-it
Container.Overview: Self-hosted tracker for games and gaming hardware: purchases, playtime per device, cost per hour, journal and wishlist. LAN / WireGuard only, no login.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the web app and the API

Config.Name: Allowed networks
Config.Description: Comma-separated source networks that may use the app, e.g. 192.168.178.0/24,10.253.0.0/24 (LAN + WireGuard). Empty = all private ranges.

Config.Name: RAWG API key
Config.Description: Free key from rawg.io for game info and images (optional)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the files in /data

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the files in /data
